name: Rainbow Chard

companions.note: Compatible spacing; green onion deters soft-bodied pests

pnw_notes: One of the most productive cut-and-come-again greens for the PNW. Tolerates summer heat and winter cold better than most leafy greens. The colored stems stay vibrant. One of the best beardie greens.

frost_hardiness.notes: Survives light frosts; repeated hard freezes damage the stems. Row cover below 25°F; outer leaves protect the crown.

planting_windows.notes: Spring sowing; thin to 6 in for full-size plants
Cut outer leaves 2 in above soil; regrows throughout the season
